reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers factory manufacture of complete tractor-mounted or trailed hay tedders, rotary or wheel rakes, and non-cutting machines that rearrange loose mown forage into swaths, including combined tedder-rakes. It covers mechanical crop handling within that operation, not storage or transport. Exclude grass cutting, mower-conditioners, balers, bale wrappers, forage harvesters, forage wagons, tractors, standalone replacement parts, crop production, field use, maintenance and end of life. A representative route purchases finished spring tines and drive components, fabricates structures when done on site, finishes them where applicable, assembles the configured machine and tests it at the factory. KUHN and KRONE sources demonstrate configuration examples; they do not establish a universal bill of materials, mandatory production route, weight or lifetime. Manufacturer use-performance claims do not define this manufacturing reference.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete tedders, rotary and wheel rakes, combined tedder-rakes and non-cutting swath-handling machines
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Mowers, balers, wrappers, forage harvesters, transport wagons, tractors and separately sold parts
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Complete accepted machine at factory dispatch gate; installed parts included, transport packaging excluded from net mass

inventory_flow_uuids.explanation: The candidate ce3ac926 has a non-alloy name/classification but an alloy-steel general comment; other candidates confuse sheet, sections, alloy or bilingual identity. No unambiguous sheet identity adopted.
English and Chinese searches return generic wire, flux-cored wire, welding service or electrically conducting solid wire, not verified solid steel arc-welding consumable.
Argon and 氩气 searches returned unrelated chemicals; no public product-flow identity was verified for pure argon shielding gas.
No compatible public solid steel-grinding-dust waste identity established; search candidates cannot substitute airborne particulate or mixed hazardous waste.
Candidate 6827e314 is a hydrometallurgical-recycling-route flow; direct read does not establish compatibility with general purchased cleaning reagent hydration/purity and route.

Public generic candidate 363302a6 has reference property UUID d6b6a36c (Aluminium content), not Mass, despite its short-description label. Candidate 9aa53a82 is CN-specific; a generic factory scope cannot assume that geography.
Candidate 4f1a3f41 is publicly typed Product flow rather than Waste flow; other wastewater candidates have incompatible industrial routes or treatment states.
No verified finished haymaking spring-steel tine product identity; generic wire and baling wire do not represent this component.
Search returned wind-turbine gearboxes or generic transmission candidates, not a verified haymaking rotor gearbox.
Generic fastener and screw candidates do not establish hexagonal-head bolt type, grade and coating identity.
Inspected public tyre candidates are motorcycle, bicycle, passenger-car or retreaded tyres; agricultural machinery compatibility not established.
No compatible guarded agricultural PTO shaft identity; search candidates concern complete equipment, axles or unrelated compounds.
Candidates are cylinder blanks, machined parts or aggregated subcomponent kits, not a complete hydraulic folding cylinder.
No candidate establishes both mineral-oil origin and lithium-soap thickener; generic lubricant and textile-oil flows are incompatible.
Candidate e64eb06c names polyethylene film but is classified as luggage/handbags; source identity inconsistency and fossil-origin compatibility remain unresolved.

evidence_needs: No manufacturer source establishes factory inventory amounts or category-wide ranges. All applicable quantities require foreground collection; no weight, lifetime, loss or emission factor is invented.

Factory-specific BOM, actual route completeness, supply voltage, missing upstream/transport/treatment links and allocation drivers require dataset-level evidence before a complete manufacturing dataset claim.
